signature: products(after: String, cultureName: String, currencyCode: String, custom: String, facet: String, filter: String, first: Int, fuzzy: Boolean, fuzzyLevel: Int, preserveUserQuery: Boolean, previousOutline: String, productIds: [String], query: String, selectedAddress: String, selectedAddressId: String, sort: String, storeId: String!, userId: String): ProductConnection

args.name: after
args.description: Only return edges after the specified cursor.

args.name: cultureName
args.description: The culture name for cart context product

args.name: currencyCode
args.description: The currency for which all prices data will be returned

args.name: custom
args.description: Can be used for custom query parameters

args.name: facet
args.description: Facets calculate statistical counts to aid in faceted navigation.

args.name: filter
args.description: This parameter applies a filter to the query results

args.name: first
args.description: Specifies the maximum number of edges to return, starting after the cursor specified by 'after', or the first number of edges if 'after' is not specified.

args.name: fuzzy
args.description: When the fuzzy query parameter is set to true the search endpoint will also return products that contain slight differences to the search text.

args.name: fuzzyLevel
args.description: The fuzziness level is quantified in terms of the Damerau-Levenshtein distance, this distance being the number of operations needed to transform one word into another.

args.name: preserveUserQuery
args.description: When true, the search query and filters will not be modified by the application

args.name: query
args.description: The query parameter performs the full-text search

args.name: selectedAddress
args.description: The shipping address to which the products are to be delivered

args.name: storeId
args.description: The store id where products are searched

args.name: userId
args.description: The customer id for search result impersonation
